name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
US inflation is diverging from the Fed’s target:

US CPI Inflation has surged +30.2% since January 2020, to an all-time high.

This translates into an annualized inflation rate of +4.0% over this period.

Meanwhile, under a steady 2% annual inflation target, cumulative CPI growth would have been just +14.3%.

In other words, actual cumulative inflation is +15.9 percentage points above the target path, more than double the implied increase.

This comes as CPI has remained above 2% for 67 consecutive months.

The gap began widening again in March, as inflation has now remained above 3% for 7 consecutive months.

Asset owners are the only winners.

text:
For almost all of human history, the rule was simple: the majority crushes the minority.

The heretic at the stake. The Jew driven from town to town. The homosexual thrown in prison. A genius destroyed by the morality of the majority. One of the most shameful pages of the 20th century.

That tyranny was real. It had to end. And it is ending.

text:
Intelligence is not what separated the great founders of the last 40 years from everyone else.

The world is full of brilliant people. Most of them never built anything that mattered.

The real difference is courage. The courage to say what you believe is true, knowing that 90% of people, sometimes more, will tell you you're wrong.

Jobs telling the world that normal people would want a computer at home. Bezos selling books on the internet while analysts laughed at his losses.
